commands.name: Set diamonds
commands.description: Sets the diamond balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

commands.name: Set money balance
commands.description: Sets the money balance from 0 to 1,000,000,000.

commands.name: Unlimited supplies
commands.description: Refills supplies to the current maximum and prevents levels from consuming them.

commands.name: Food never burns
commands.description: Freezes timers that would burn prepared food.

commands.name: In-level coin multiplier
commands.description: Multiplies coins from served food and combo bonuses during a level.

commands.name: Combo never expires
commands.description: Stops the active combo from expiring.

commands.name: Quick level completion
commands.description: Wins the active level after you deliver every item in one customer order.
